{'text': '隨着亞馬遜秋季Prime Day活動正式展開，現在正是更新你嘅AirPods嘅最佳時機之一。雖然我哋仲未見到Apple最新AirPods 5系列有節日級優惠價，但既然AirPods Pro 3減到咁低，對大部分人嚟講可能反而係更好嘅選擇；而想體驗Apple頭戴式耳機嘅朋友，2026年嘅AirPods Max 2而家全部五隻色都有120美元折扣。', 'trans_text': "As Amazon's fall Prime Day event officially kicks off, now is one of the best times to update your AirPods. Although we haven't yet seen holiday-level discounts on Apple's latest AirPods 5 lineup, since the AirPods Pro 3 has been marked down so low, it may actually be a better choice for most people; and for those who want to experience Apple's over-ear headphones, the 2026 AirPods Max 2 is currently $120 off across all five colors."}

  • {'text': 'AirPods Pro 3 $179（原價$249）', 'trans_text': 'AirPods Pro 3 $179 (originally $249)'}
  • {'text': 'AirPods Max 2 $429（原價$549）', 'trans_text': 'AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)'}

{'text': 'Apple今次以同樣$129嘅定價推出咗配備主動降噪功能嘅新入門級AirPods 5，我個人真係覺得非常驚喜——上一代冇降噪都係賣緊呢個價。不過如果你想要無線充電盒，就要加碼去到$149嗰個升級版。即係話你而家只需要多畀$30，就可以買到功能強勁好多、高階好多嘅AirPods Pro——對我嚟講呢個完全唔使諗。', 'trans_text': "Apple has launched the new entry-level AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation at the same $129 price point, which I personally find genuinely surprising — the previous generation was selling at this price without noise cancellation. However, if you want the wireless charging case, you'll need to step up to the $149 upgraded version. That means you only need to spend an extra $30 right now to get a much more powerful and premium AirPods Pro — to me, it's a complete no-brainer."}

{'text': '原價$249，而家比起標價平咗$70，距離Amazon史上最低價只差$10——呢個價錢自從推出以來我哋都只係紀錄過一次。', 'trans_text': "Originally $249, it's now $70 below the sticker price, just $10 away from Amazon's all-time low — we've only recorded this price once since its launch."}

{'text': '幾個月後我哋幾乎肯定會見到新AirPods 5嘅價錢跌到接近$100甚至更低，但根據以往經驗同埋上一代嘅走勢嚟睇，可能要等到2027年中段先會跌穿$99呢個關口。到時就算真係咁，AirPods Pro 3仍然會喺降噪效果上強3倍、續航更長、內置心率感測器、具備所有聽力輔助功能，而且喺我睇嚟佩戴貼合度都更加好。', 'trans_text': "In a few months we'll almost certainly see the new AirPods 5 price drop to around $100 or even lower, but based on past experience and the trajectory of the previous model, it may not drop below the $99 mark until mid-2027. And even if it does, the AirPods Pro 3 will still offer 3 times better noise cancellation, longer battery life, a built-in heart rate sensor, all the hearing aid features, and in my view, a better fit."}

{'text': '以上種種理由已經足以令人揀AirPods Pro 3多過新嘅5系列，不過如果你嘅目標係Apple嘅高階頭戴式耳機，咁秋季Prime Day期間2026年Max 2嘅優惠就係你嘅最佳選擇。', 'trans_text': "All these reasons are already enough to make people choose the AirPods Pro 3 over the new 5 series, but if you're after Apple's premium over-ear headphones, then the discount on the 2026 Max 2 during the fall Prime Day is your best bet."}

{'text': '而家嘅價錢只係比Amazon史上最低價高$30，五隻顏色任你揀，全部都有$120折扣。', 'trans_text': "The current price is only $30 above Amazon's all-time low, with all five colors available, all at $120 off."}

{'text': '值得一提嘅係，自從呢對耳機今年較早前推出以嚟，今次只係我哋第二次見到佢跌到呢個價位——佢嘅價錢歷來只係低過呢個價一次。', 'trans_text': "Worth noting is that since these headphones debuted earlier this year, this is only the second time we've seen them drop to this price — they've only gone lower than this once."}

{'text': '當然仲有Sony同Bose等大品牌嘅其他值得留意嘅耳機優惠（喺下面搵得到），但如果你問我，總之冇咩嘢比得上由Cupertino設計嘅個人聆聽體驗。如果你仲未有定論，喺下面亦可以搵到一啲質素唔錯嘅選擇，連同Apple生態系統入面嘅一系列矚目優惠。', 'trans_text': "Of course, there are also other notable headphone deals from major brands like Sony and Bose (which can be found below), but if you ask me, nothing compares to a personal listening experience designed by Cupertino. If you haven't decided yet, you can also find some decent alternatives below, along with a range of eye-catching deals across the Apple ecosystem."}
